definitions.gloss: a yakitori skewer of chicken alternating with pieces of leek
definitions.explanation: The standard yakitori skewer on which chunks of chicken thigh alternate with sections of {長|なが}ねぎ. Usually the first thing ordered at a yakitori shop and the benchmark by which the shop is judged.

examples.japanese: ねぎま⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦タレ→タレ：10500_tare⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ねぎま⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厚|あつ}くて→厚い：00690_atsui⟧おいしい。
examples.english: The negima at this place has thick pieces of meat and tastes great.

examples.japanese: ⟦とりあえず→とりあえず：05209_toriaezu⟧ねぎま⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{砂肝|すなぎも}→砂肝：30550_sunagimo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}んで→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧、⟦{飲|の}み{物|もの}→飲み物：02929_nomimono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧あと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{決|き}めよう→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: Let's order negima and gizzard for now and decide on drinks later.

notes:
Written in kana on almost every menu. The name comes from ねぎ (leek) plus ま, and originally referred to an Edo-period dish of leek and tuna ({鮪|まぐろ}); the chicken skewer took over the name later.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ねぎま⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦タレ→タレ：10500_tare⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: negima with the sweet soy sauce
- ねぎま⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧: negima with salt
- ねぎま{二本|にほん}: two negima skewers

USAGE:
Ordering yakitori means choosing ⟦タレ→タレ：10500_tare⟧ (sauce) or ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧ (salt) for each item, so ねぎま⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ is a complete order on its own.
